nodes.title: Player
nodes.description: Rules a kingdom: builds, trains, trades, spies, marches armies, joins an alliance and competes for land each era.

nodes.title: Developer
nodes.description: Tests the whole game from the outside and simulates worlds to check balance.

nodes.title: Game server
nodes.description: Holds every kingdom and the rules: the REST API, the turn clock, battles, the market, monuments, merchant bots and the era.

nodes.title: Kingdom
nodes.description: A kingdom at home: its state, building, training, buying land, carriers and passing turns.

nodes.title: Kingdom API
nodes.description: The /kingdom endpoints and the service that runs each action in a transaction.

nodes.title: Kingdom state and storage
nodes.description: The kingdom entity with its resources, creating new kingdoms, derived capacities, and the kingdom repositories.

nodes.title: Buildings and land
nodes.description: Building and demolishing, great works and their levels, and buying land.

nodes.title: Training
nodes.description: Training and dismissing workers and soldiers, and the kingdom's unit counts.

nodes.title: Carriers
nodes.description: Sending goods to another kingdom by carrier and calling carriers back.

nodes.title: Turns
nodes.description: Hands every kingdom a new turn on the wall clock's whole periods and runs a passed turn: harvest, upkeep, production, arrivals, fortune and the turn report.

nodes.title: War
nodes.description: Armies, allied garrisons, spies, and the battle and spy reports.

nodes.title: Armies and battles
nodes.description: Sending and recalling attacks, joined strikes, reinforcements standing guard with allies, and resolving battles when armies land.

nodes.title: Spies and reports
nodes.description: Spy missions and the stored battle and spy reports, served at /war.

nodes.title: Market and merchant bots
nodes.description: Player-to-player trade, and the merchant bots that trade there.

nodes.title: Market
nodes.description: Posting, buying and withdrawing offers, allies' offers, transactions and price averages on a timer.

nodes.title: Merchant bots
nodes.description: Farmer, gold miner, iron miner and blacksmith kingdoms that build, train and trade every few seconds, under caps.

nodes.title: Alliances and monuments
nodes.description: Coalitions of up to ten kingdoms, and the monument an alliance raises together.

nodes.title: Alliances
nodes.description: Founding and leaving alliances, invitations, members and bots, and the war room an alliance shares.

nodes.title: Monuments
nodes.description: The monument an emperor founds once an era: contributions, stages that rise and crumble, its garrison and assaults on it.

nodes.title: Letters and chronicle
nodes.description: Letters between rulers and to a whole alliance, and the chronicle of what happened to a kingdom.

nodes.title: Eras and rankings
nodes.description: Ends an era when its clock runs out, records the winning alliance in the hall of fame, resets every realm, and serves the rankings.

nodes.title: Accounts and sign-in
nodes.description: Registration, play-now trial accounts and keeping them, login with JWT, the token filter and CORS.

nodes.title: Game rules and shared model
nodes.description: The balance numbers from gameconfig.json, and the names, ids and answer shape every feature shares.

nodes.title: Balance config
nodes.description: gameconfig.json read into typed settings: costs, production, battle, espionage, events, monuments, era length and bot caps.

nodes.title: Shared model
nodes.description: Resource, building and unit names, unit counts, ids, the action answer, the API description and the conflict handler.

nodes.title: Startup and world seeding
nodes.description: Boots the server, answers /health, and seeds the bots, starting kingdoms and, locally only, the development accounts.

nodes.title: Simulation edge
nodes.description: Only in the simulation profile: moves the clock, ends the era and lists kingdoms for the acceptance tools.

nodes.title: Game client
nodes.description: The browser game: the landing page, sign-in, and the kingdom's pages, refreshed from the game server.

nodes.title: App shell
nodes.description: Starts the app, routes between pages, and frames them with the side rail, the top bar of every store with its next-turn forecast, and a thumb bar on phones.

nodes.title: Sign-in and play now
nodes.description: The landing page, sign-in and registration, play now with only a kingdom name, and keeping a trial kingdom.

nodes.title: Pages
nodes.description: One page per part of the game: your turn, build, train, war, spies, market, carriers, alliance and its monument, letters, chronicle and rankings.

nodes.title: Game state and advice
nodes.description: The kingdom kept fresh for every page, what waits on the ruler this turn, building plans, rule mirrors and the game's words.

nodes.title: API client
nodes.description: Every server call, the token and trial session, and the types generated from the server's OpenAPI description.

nodes.title: UI kit
nodes.description: Icons, crests, tooltips, shared page parts and number formatting.

nodes.title: Game database
nodes.technology: PostgreSQL · Flyway (in-memory H2 for simulations, unless the suite runs them on PostgreSQL)
nodes.description: The world: accounts, kingdoms, armies, alliances, monuments, bots, market, letters, chronicle, reports and eras.

nodes.title: Development tools
nodes.description: Acceptance tools: the server and pages started for tests, the API client, and the world simulations for balance and A/B reports.
